description: MPS bond dimension benchmark output format.

columns.name: depth
columns.description: Circuit depth at which this measurement was taken (even layers only).

columns.name: entropy_nats
columns.description: Half-chain von Neumann entanglement entropy from the statevector simulator, computed at the same depth.

columns.name: chi_max
columns.description: Maximum bond dimension across all MPS bonds at this depth.

columns.name: avg_chi
columns.description: Average bond dimension across all MPS bonds at this depth.
